what_it_does: NodeSentry is an automatic anomaly detector for large high-performance computing clusters that identifies nodes behaving abnormally. In massive systems, nodes frequently transition between different jobs and experience complex performance patterns, making manual detection impractical. This unsupervised system automatically detects unusual node behavior at scale by combining coarse-grained clustering (grouping nodes by similarity) with fine-grained model sharing (transferring learned patterns between nodes).
